entities.summary: Lamont Da Sean "MoMo" Jones is an American professional basketball player for Al Qurain of the Kuwaiti Division I Basketball League. He was a standout college player for Iona College and was an honorable mention All-American and conference player of the year as a senior. He also played at the University of Arizona.
